tasks.task: Write the weekly marketing report

items.when: Every week on the same day, to gather exports, check them and send one page
When GA4, ad and store exports are in and the owner needs one page read in two minutes
When the first report is due and the numbers have never been defined
Before the report goes out, to check the method, the sums and any bias
When the draft is full of analyst terms, to rewrite it in plain business words
When the page shows every number and the reader cannot tell what to do

tasks.task: Agree one set of marketing numbers

items.when: When team and agency count spend, leads or sales differently and meetings start with a row
When one metric needs a single written definition the whole team can reuse
When two reports show different figures for the same thing and you need the difference table
When a number changed meaning over time and you must find where
When the list is full of numbers that look good and explain nothing

tasks.task: Write a GA4 event and key event plan

items.when: When a developer or agency must build tracking from the plan without a meeting
When you start from what must be measured and need events, names and tags
When the site is a Shopify store and purchase tracking needs a build checklist
When the plan is drafted, to catch missing day-one settings and store events

tasks.task: Check the current tracking set-up and verify a launch

items.when: For a new site or flow, an audit that found problems, or before a big campaign
When GA4, Meta and campaign links all need fixing before spend goes up
When what counts as a sale or lead is agreed and the tags need repair
When Google Ads may count a purchase twice, to get a pass or fail and the fix
Each month, to catch broken tracking and double counts before they reach a report

tasks.task: Clean up UTM links and write the rules

items.when: When links are spelt many ways and traffic lands in Unassigned or not set
When each campaign needs tagged links and rules the store can match
When visits and orders must be sorted into the same channels whatever tool they came from
When you want revenue by campaign from the store's own order lines

tasks.task: Explain why GA4, ad platforms and the store disagree

items.when: When every tool reports a different sales total and the owner asks which to believe
When you need the platforms side by side with the reason for each gap
When ad numbers are pasted in, to explain each metric and reconcile the platforms

tasks.task: Size the gap between GA4 and real sales by region

items.when: When GA4 shows fewer sales than the store and the business sells into several regions
When the GA4 export is in BigQuery and you need counts that match or explain the screen
When GA4 orders and store orders must be matched row by row to find what is missing

tasks.task: Explain how each channel gets credit

items.when: When reports conflict and you must pick a model and a way to settle disputes
When survey answers can show which channels the platforms over-credit
When the owner needs a plain how-this-was-worked-out note with its limits
When last-click makes short-term channels look good and brand work look useless

tasks.task: Give a fair read of channel results

items.when: When you have the numbers and need trends, funnel drop-offs and next steps
When you need the cost to win one new customer from each traffic source
Each month, to check returns against store totals and spot fading channels

tasks.task: Plan a holdout or regional lift test

items.when: Once a quarter on the channel most in doubt, or before a big budget decision
When you need the regions, length, noise check and decision rule set before the test
When the doubt is about one channel or change and a simple holdout will answer it
When you know spend and regions and need a lift test sized to them
Before the test starts, to log each assumption and what would change the answer

tasks.task: Read out a lift test or an A/B test

items.when: When the test has ended and the result must be read against the rule set beforehand
When each test needs a readiness check before and an honest verdict after
When the numbers are in, to decide whether to trust them and state the lift as a range
When a lift figure needs its uncertainty explained in a way the owner can use

tasks.task: Plan an A/B test the traffic can prove

items.when: When a change needs a clear hypothesis, a test plan and a way to read the result
Before the test, to work out how many visitors or orders it needs
When traffic is low, to see how many weeks the test would take and whether to run it

tasks.task: Work out the customer cost limit

items.when: Before raising or cutting spend, to set the most to pay for a new customer from margins
When the limit should come with a truer return figure and a lift test
When you have cohort profit, to check the ratio and get a scale or fix call
When repeat buying matters, to read lifetime value and true payback by cohort

tasks.task: Write a build sheet for a one-page dashboard

items.when: When the owner wants one page on top of GA4 and store data and someone else will build it
Before the build sheet, to settle who reads it and what they decide from it
When a self-contained page with charts and filters will do instead of a hosted tool
When one number needs a clean chart of the right type

tasks.task: Judge whether a media mix model is worth it

items.when: When a model is proposed or delivered and you must judge if the data can support it
When a simple model of what each channel adds will do, with honest limits
When a vendor's model arrives, to check its method and sums before anyone acts

tasks.task: Recommend how to split budget across channels

items.when: When you have spend by channel and margin and need a target split with caps
When a new budget is proposed, to compare low and high forecasts with diminishing returns
When the split is live, to check each month where the next pound should go

tasks.task: Find where the funnel leaks

items.when: When you have an event log and steps and need conversion and drop-off per step
When CRM stages and spend are known and you need the true cost of each stage
When you have GA4 funnel and device numbers and want the step that leaks most
Before trusting lead reports, to see if the source field is good enough

tasks.task: Explain a sudden drop or spike

items.when: When a number moved, to confirm it, split it by group and rank the main driver
When the drop is in search traffic and you need likely causes ranked
Before blaming one cause, to list rival explanations and how to test each

tasks.task: Forecast results and set targets

items.when: When you have numbers over time and need trend, seasons, odd spikes and a forecast table
When the forecast is drafted, to log what it assumes and what could change it
When a target is vague and should be a dated forecast checked against a base rate

tasks.task: Clean and join exports before analysis

items.when: When an export has blanks, duplicates, wrong types and outliers
When two exports are joined, to list unmatched rows and duplicate keys
When a dataset feeds a regular report and needs standing checks
When ad and sales data sit in BigQuery, to find spend gaps and double counts first

tasks.task: Read a how-did-you-hear survey

items.when: When you have survey answers and channel spend and want over-credited channels named
When the survey answers look too neat, to score how far to trust them
When buyers may arrive from AI answers and nothing records it yet

tasks.task: Write up findings an owner can act on

items.when: When the analysis is done, to rank the findings by impact and how sure each is
When a long analysis needs one page with the answer first
Before sending, to read the write-up as the owner would and list what is unclear
When the numbers live in a workbook, to find broken formulas and wrong totals

tasks.task: Set up brand and long-term measures

items.when: When the owner asks if brand work is doing anything and nothing tracks it
When short-term and long-term measures should sit on one scorecard
When every measure is short-term and the plan starves what builds future demand

always.when: Before any analysis is shared, to check the method, the sums and any bias
Before a workbook leaves your hands, to find broken formulas and wrong totals
Before anything goes to an owner, to replace analyst terms with plain words

helpers.when: When the dashboard must be built and kept running, not only specified
When exports must become a pipeline or a warehouse table that refreshes
When a media mix model or a synthetic-control test needs real modelling
When tags, pixels or the data layer must be changed inside the store
When the read of results should turn into bid, budget and campaign changes
When the funnel leak is found and the page needs tests to fix it

gaps: No library item audits a Google Tag Manager container or writes a data layer spec
No library item covers consent mode and cookie banners: what they hide from GA4 and how to size it by region
No library item writes a Looker Studio or Data Studio build sheet; the dashboard items make their own pages
No library item builds a media mix model or reviews one a vendor has delivered
No library item designs a regional test with matched regions, a noise check or synthetic control; only the kit does
No library item audits a live GA4 property beyond store set-up: cross-domain, filters, retention and key events
No library item covers server-side tagging for Google or importing offline and phone sales
No library item checks a weekly report's totals against the store or CRM backend; only the kit does
No library item tracks share of search or benchmarks traffic against named rivals
